overview: The Medford City Council received a presentation on the upcoming Relay for Life, heard public comment on the municipal parking system and the Brooks Estate, and approved pedestrian safety improvements for McNally Park. The council also voted to send a proposed process for addressing unanswered council resolutions to the Subcommittee on Rules.

items.title: Commendations
items.summary: Tabled two commendations offered by Councilor Knight until the following week.

items.title: Medford Relay for Life Presentation
items.summary: Received a presentation from representatives of the American Cancer Society and the Medford-Somerville Relay for Life regarding their June 5 event at Hormel Stadium and placed the matter on file.

items.title: New Building Department Employees
items.summary: Approved a resolution welcoming new building department employees Steve Campoli, Steve Randazzo, and Peter Spock.

items.title: Crosswalk on Forest Street for McNally Park
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a crosswalk on Forest Street between King Avenue and Cedar Road to provide safe pedestrian access to McNally Park.

items.title: Public Comment on Republic Parking System
items.summary: Resident Jim Bilodeau voiced concerns regarding ticketing and kiosks under the Republic Parking contract, and councilors clarified that administrative contract authority lies with the mayor and Traffic Commission ahead of an upcoming joint committee meeting.

items.title: Subcommittee Referral of Unanswered Resolutions
items.summary: Referred a proposal to send unanswered 2014 council resolutions to subcommittees to the Subcommittee on Rules, following council debate concerning executive accountability and compliance with the city charter.

items.title: Withdrawal of Resolution 15-358
items.summary: Withdrew the resolution at the sponsor's request after the administration received a federal response.

items.title: Memorial Adjournment and Recognitions
items.summary: Voted to adjourn in memory of late State Senator Charles E. Shannon on the tenth anniversary of his death, congratulated Stella Tenaglia on her retirement, and extended condolences on the passing of Marie Donato.

items.title: Petition on Brooks Estate and Public Buildings
items.summary: Resident Jeanne Martin petitioned the council to halt restoration efforts at the Brooks Estate and redirect municipal funds toward public safety and core infrastructure.

items.title: Jobs and Infrastructure Petition
items.summary: Tabled a petition regarding jobs and infrastructure.

items.title: Update on 59 Boynton Road
items.summary: Councilor Marks reported that legal and health department reviews are proceeding and expected court actions within six to eight weeks could enable the sale, rehabilitation, or demolition of the blighted property.
